item.title: The Aravallis — Defining an eco-system with a tape measure
item.description: One hopes the court listens to experts and science, stops carving up the Aravallis for mining, and declares the entire range an Eco-Sensitive Zone. With 30% already lost, protecting what remains is a duty owed to future generations.

item.title: Voter roll hearings in Bengal trigger distress among elderly and vulnerable
item.description: West Bengal’s SIR is no longer just a technical exercise. Block offices have become sites of fear, with elderly, disabled and poor voters forced into hardship, long journeys and lost wages just to prove they belong on the rolls.

item.title: Trump threatens Colombia and hints at further US action in Latin America
item.description: Donald Trump has issued fresh threats against Colombia and hinted at further US military action in Latin America, days after American forces seized Venezuela’s leader in a controversial operation that has sparked outrage across the region.

item.title: Nicolas Maduro’s seizure fuels fears of wider conflict with Iran
item.description: The US seizure of Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro has sent shockwaves beyond Latin America, with analysts warning it could raise the risk of a wider conflict with Iran amid already high Middle East tensions.
